title: Canva CONTENT CREATOR
qualification: Camera-friendly and comfortable appearing in videos and reels. Good knowledge of social media trends and content creation. Basic to good video editing skills and proficiency in Canva. Good communication skills in English and Hindi.
other_details: Job Type: Full-Time. Preference: Female candidates. Key Responsibilities: Create engaging ideas for social media videos and reels. Stay updated with trends and suggest new content ideas.
